network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
notFound: This no longer exists. It may have been removed.
tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
invalid: Some details aren't right. Check them and try again.

reasons.MISSING_PERMISSION: Your role doesn't allow this. Ask an Owner or Admin.
reasons.NOT_A_MEMBER: You're not a member of an organization.
reasons.OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner can do this.
reasons.OWNER_ROLE_IS_FIXED: The Owner role always holds every permission and can't be changed.
reasons.CANNOT_CHANGE_YOURSELF: You can't change your own role or remove yourself.
reasons.EXCEEDS_YOUR_PERMISSIONS: You can only give permissions you hold yourself.
reasons.ENABLE_TWO_FACTOR_FIRST: Turn on two-factor sign-in for yourself first.
reasons.LAST_OWNER: The organization needs at least one Owner.
reasons.STAFF_CHANGED: Someone changed this person at the same time. Look again and retry.
reasons.EMAIL_OR_USERNAME_TAKEN: That email or username is already in use.
reasons.EMAIL_OR_USERNAME_REQUIRED: Give an email, a username or both.
reasons.INVALID_USERNAME: Usernames use 2-32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
reasons.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer on the staff list.
reasons.ROLE_IN_USE: Staff still have this role. Give them another role first.
reasons.ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: Another role already has this name.
reasons.SCOPE_REQUIRED: Choose whether this role sees its own records or all of them.
reasons.SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only view permissions take a scope.
reasons.UNKNOWN_PERMISSION: One of these permissions doesn't exist any more. Reload and try again.
reasons.PLATFORM_ONLY: Only platform staff can do this.
reasons.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists. It may have been removed.
reasons.SEAT_LIMIT_REACHED: Every seat on your plan is taken. Remove someone, or ask for more seats.
reasons.IMPERSONATING: Only the person themselves can do this, not support signed in as them.
reasons.IMPERSONATION_TARGET_NOT_A_MEMBER: This person is no longer active staff, so support can't sign in as them.
reasons.TARGET_HAS_PENDING_STEP: They have to finish signing in themselves first.
reasons.NO_SUBSCRIPTION: Your organization has no subscription yet. Ask support to set one up.
reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY: Your organization is read-only until its payment is made. You can still view and export.
reasons.ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: Your organization is suspended. Only an Owner can export or remove staff.
reasons.MODULE_NOT_ON_PLAN: Your organization's plan doesn't include this.
reasons.PROFILE_NOT_SAVED: Save the business details before the branding.
reasons.ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND: This file no longer exists. It may have been removed.
reasons.ATTACHMENT_ID_IN_USE: This file was saved already. Reload to see it.
reasons.SYSTEM_OWNED_FILE: This file belongs to its record and can't be removed.
reasons.SENSITIVE_FILE: Your role can't open sensitive files. Ask an Owner or Admin.
reasons.STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: Your organization's file storage is full. Ask support for more storage.
reasons.UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The file didn't arrive. Upload it again.
reasons.UPLOAD_EXPIRED: This upload was left too long to finish. Upload the file again.
reasons.UPLOAD_DOES_NOT_MATCH: The file that arrived isn't the one you chose. Upload it again.
reasons.LOGO_TOO_LARGE: This image is too large for a logo. Use one at most 4096 pixels wide and high, and 16 megapixels in all.
reasons.INVALID_FILE_NAME: This file's name can't be used. Rename it and try again.
reasons.EMPTY_FILE: This file is empty. Choose another.
reasons.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: The document is still being prepared. Try again in a minute.
reasons.SAMPLE_LIMIT_REACHED: You've made 50 samples in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
reasons.INVALID_DOCUMENT: This document can't be issued as it is. Check its details.
reasons.UNPRINTABLE_CHARACTERS: The document has characters its PDF can't show yet. Remove them and try again.
reasons.INVALID_RECORD_TYPE: This can't be shared by link.
reasons.INVALID_RECORD_ID: This can't be shared by link.
reasons.INVALID_LABEL: Give the link a label of up to 200 characters.
reasons.EXPIRY_IN_THE_PAST: Choose an expiry date in the future.
reasons.LINK_REVOKED: This link has been turned off.
reasons.NOT_A_PERSON: Only a signed-in person has notifications.
reasons.INVALID_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION: Notifications can't be turned on in this browser.
reasons.INVALID_PREFERENCE: That notification setting can't be saved. Reload and try again.
reasons.INVALID_PAGE: The next page didn't load. Reload and try again.
reasons.INVALID_MARK_READ: These notifications couldn't be marked as read. Reload and try again.
reasons.SUPER_ADMIN_ONLY: Only a super admin can do this.
reasons.STAFF_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer on the platform staff.
reasons.STAFF_EMAIL_TAKEN: Someone already has this email address.
reasons.EVER_A_MEMBER: Someone who is or was a member of an organization can't be platform staff.
reasons.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: The platform needs at least one super admin.
reasons.ORGANIZATION_CODE_TAKEN: Another organization has that code. Choose another.
reasons.ROLES_ALREADY_SEEDED: This organization has its roles already.
reasons.NO_EMAIL: This person has no email address to send an invite to.
reasons.PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET: This person has a password already. They can reset it from the sign-in page.
reasons.PLAN_KEY_TAKEN: Another plan has that key. Choose another.
reasons.PLAN_KEY_RESERVED: That key is the demo plan's. Choose another.
reasons.PLAN_CYCLE_IN_USE: Organizations pay for this plan that way, so that price can't be removed.
reasons.PLAN_ARCHIVED: That plan is no longer sold.
reasons.DEMO_PLAN_LOCKED: The demo's own plan can't be archived.
reasons.SUBSCRIPTION_EXISTS: This organization has a subscription already.
reasons.SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED: A cancelled subscription can't be suspended. A payment, or a paid-through day from today on, brings it back.
reasons.PAID_THROUGH_REQUIRED: Give a trial end date, or a paid-through date from today on.
reasons.TRIAL_END_IN_PAST: A trial must end today or later.
reasons.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: Type the organization's code exactly as shown to confirm.
reasons.CANCEL_FIRST: Cancel the organization's subscription before deleting it for good.
reasons.REMOVE_FIRST: Remove this person from the organization before erasing them.
reasons.EXPORT_FIRST: Export it first: a purge or an erasure needs an export from the last day.
reasons.KEPT_BY_LAW: Issued documents are kept as issued, as the law requires. Erase the person they're about instead.
reasons.NOT_PERSONAL_DATA: Only a record of a person, such as a traveller, can be erased.
reasons.EXPORT_NOT_READY: This export isn't finished yet. Try again in a few minutes.
reasons.EXPORT_EXPIRED: This export has expired. Ask for a new one.
reasons.FAILED_JOB_NOT_FOUND: This job is no longer in the failed list. It may have run again.
reasons.NOT_RETRYABLE: A deletion, erasure or export isn't run again: ask for it again, so every check is made again.
reasons.SCHEDULE_IS_THE_CONSOLES: The console schedules this job every time it starts, so it can't be removed.

auth.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: That email and password don't match.
auth.INVALID_USERNAME_OR_PASSWORD: That organization code, username and password don't match.
auth.VALIDATION: Give your organization code, username and password.
auth.BANNED_USER: This account can't sign in. Ask your organization's admin.
auth.NEW_PASSWORD_MUST_DIFFER: Choose a password different from the current one.
auth.INVALID_CODE: That code isn't right. Codes change every 30 seconds.
auth.INVALID_BACKUP_CODE: That backup code isn't right, or it was used already.
auth.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE: Your sign-in timed out. Start again.
auth.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS_REQUEST_NEW_CODE: Too many wrong codes. Start signing in again.
auth.INVALID_TOKEN: This reset link has expired or was used already. Ask for a new one.
auth.RESET_PASSWORD_DISABLED: Password reset by email isn't available yet. Ask your organization's admin.
auth.INVALID_REDIRECT_URL: Password reset doesn't work from this address. Ask your organization's admin.
auth.TOTP_ALREADY_ENABLED: Two-factor sign-in is already on for your account.
auth.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Signing in is locked for 15 minutes; try again after that.
